title: Introduce theme-inversion tokens and stabilize icon affordances across densities
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Problem: Several product teams reported inconsistent icon button visuals when switching themes and under high-density layouts (small touch targets). Issues include icon contrast inversion bugs, outline bleeding at high DPI, and loading/disabled visual regressions after the recent theme tokens refactor. This ticket proposes a discrete token set and visual rules for 'theme-inversion' flows and a small set of affordance stabilizations for icon and compact action surfaces. Goal: deliver a robust token surface that preserves contrast/accessibility, predictable hit visuals across densities, and clear regressions to rollout to vNext component release.
decisions: Add a dedicated token namespace: token.button.inversion.* (foreground, border, shadow, hover) to keep inverted-theme overrides isolated from base tokens
Favor silhouette contrast anchors over dual-tint overlays for icon inversion to reduce runtime blending complexity
Limit densest layout visual deltas to color + outline thickness changes; avoid layout shifts for hitbox and baseline spacing
Introduce a single opt-in 'invertible' flag on IconButton component rather than global theme hooks to minimize accidental inversions in nested components

acceptance_criteria: Token namespace token.button.inversion.* land in design tokens package and published to staging
IconButton + CompactAction components honor 'invertible' flag with zero layout shift
Contrast anchors meet WCAG AA (>=4.5:1) for small icon sizes and all supported theme combinations
No visual regressions in baseline screenshot comparisons (Percy) for the affected routes: product-header, compact-toolbar, message-list actions
Documentation added: token migration notes, usage examples, and when to use invertible vs base styling
qa_steps: 1) Toggle site theme light->dark->light on staging while observing header and toolbar icons
2) Validate contrast using built-in axe checks and manual color measurement (Figma color inspector) on small icon sizes (16px, 20px)
3) Test high-density devices (pixel ratio >=2) and confirm outline edges do not produce visible aliasing
4) Confirm disabled/in-flight states render consistent overlays without changing hitbox size
5) Run visual diff against master baselines for product-header, toolbar, and message-row action sets
implementation_notes: - Add token namespace to tokens repo: token.button.inversion.fg, .bg, .border, .hover, .focus-ring
- Expose 'invertible' boolean prop in IconButton API and wire to CSS custom properties at runtime
- Use silhouette contrast anchors: precomputed high-contrast icons where inversion is enabled (build step SVG variant generation)
- Add a per-component unit test ensuring no layout shift when toggling invertible prop
- Coordinate with ENG-20012 to apply subpixel antialiasing CSS workarounds for Safari rounding issues
- Add Percy stories for all density and theme permutations (small/medium/large, light/dark/inverted)
- Update Storybook docs with a migration note and code examples for invertible usage
